trust_decision.summary: A user's project permissions are decided by resolving the stored role slug through the store and trusting the DB row's `permissions` column, so any role row whose slug equals a built-in slug (owner/manager/task_runner/guest) replaces the code-defined permissions; the fix makes built-in slugs authoritative in code and confines the SQL slug lookup to the project or global scope.

landing_point.why: It is the single place every project route turns a stored role slug into a permission set for GetMustCanMiddleware, so a reader of 'custom-role slug collision' looks here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: all authenticated HTTP routes under /api/project/{project_id}/... mounted with projects.ProjectMiddleware (api/router.go:294, api/router.go:364, api/router.go:380)
POST/PUT /api/project/{project_id}/users[/{user_id}] via api/projects/users.go:90 and api/projects/users.go:180, plus ProjectMiddleware itself
fix_sites.module_kind: SQL store implementation of the public db.Store interface (db/Store.go:517)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/project/{project_id}/tasks/{task_id}/start|stop via api/projects/tasks.go:128, and any project route carrying template_id via api/projects/project.go:67
fix_sites.module_kind: SQL store query for template-level permissions

fix_sites.entry_point: no in-repo caller: the pro role endpoints that would call it are 404 stubs (pro/api/roles.go:28-63), so only db.Store.CreateRole callers exist here

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The BoltDB store is the deprecated legacy backend (util/config.go:39, db/factory/store.go:18-19) and the advisory's store-level hunk only touched db/sql, so its unscoped `role.Slug == slug` lookup looks like an unrelated leftover once the middleware guard stops built-in slugs from shadowing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Global roles (project_id IS NULL) must stay resolvable for project users and project restore must keep importing roles under freshly generated slugs; the fixed SQL lookup therefore keeps `or project_id is null` (db/sql/role.go:61) and services/project/restore.go:57 randomises the slug. An over-broad fix that drops every DB role lookup, or filters only `project_id=?`, breaks global custom roles and role restore.

O6_input_shapes: role slug as a plain JSON string in the user body: {"role": "manager"} on project user add/update (api/projects/users.go:82, api/projects/users.go:172)
each built-in slug string: owner, manager, task_runner, guest (db/ProjectUser.go:5-11)
empty slug "" (db.ProjectNone), which created a role row with no name/slug guard
arbitrary custom slug string stored in the role table (project-scoped project_id=<id> or global project_id IS NULL)
case/spelling variants such as "Manager", which are not IsValid and are therefore treated as custom roles

O8_uncovered_routes.route: On a BoltDB deployment, POST /api/project/{project_id}/users accepts a custom role slug that exists only in another project (unscoped bolt lookup), and ProjectMiddleware then grants that other project's role permissions here
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: BoltDB is deprecated in favour of sqlite and the advisory's store hunk only changed the SQL implementation, so the bolt copy reads as a legacy duplicate nobody needs to touch
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: db/bolt package, 3 packages from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI `semaphore migrate --from-boltdb` recreates role rows with their original slugs through the exporter and never calls db.ValidateRole, so the new reserved-slug rule is not enforced on the import path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is an offline, admin-only migration of a legacy bolt file (cli/cmd/migrate.go:59) and reads more like data plumbing than a role-creation entry point
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: services/export + cli packages, away from every file the advisory names

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the interface method already exists twice (db/Store.go:517, db/sql/role.go:59, db/bolt/role.go:79) and backends drift apart exactly like this

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already calls the same store method twice, before the fix exists, to validate role strings on user add/update

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the list-view twin of GetTemplatePermission written by a different author and never routed through the role resolver

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a role exporter/importer that preserves the source slug on restore
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the entity exporter pattern is copy-pasted per entity and role is the only one whose natural key is also a security-relevant name

O9_family: improper privilege management / authorization bypass via identifier collision (role-slug shadowing)

O10_build.toolchain: go build ./... / go test ./... with modules vendored in the module cache; pro is a local replace (go.mod:22, go.mod:37)
O10_build.project_tests: Taskfile.yml:139-142 runs `go test -v -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...`; db tests are unit-level (db/bolt/*_test.go use bbolt files, db/sql/SqlDb_test.go only builds dialect SQL), db/ProjectUser_test.go covers the built-in permission map, and .dredd integration tests need a running server plus node so they are not usable here. The fix adds db/Role_test.go, which does not exist at the pinned commit.
